snippet.title: Meet Stridewing - Your Wildest Travel Companion in TESERA
snippet.description:
Meet the Stridewing - a curious and agile creature unlike anything else in Tesera.

Alongside this new companion, you’ll explore the world above in an unforgettable flight across breathtaking biomes. But not everything in Tesera is peaceful - deep below, abandoned machines still stir…

🌍 Tesera - A sandbox survival world full of mystery, danger, and untold stories.

💡 Support the development of Tesera!
If you enjoyed, add Tesera to your Steam Wishlist and join the upcoming Playtest.
Your support means the world to us and helps shape the future of this sandbox survival adventure.

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3258010/Tesera/
🌐 Website / Browser Version: https://tesera.io
📌 Check out our development roadmap here: https://landing.tesera.io/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/8C72nfZ3WR
🎵 Music specially composed by @artovskih
